mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses risk-free rates, increasing equity valuation multiples and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through discounted cash flow effects.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month consecutive rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering corporate revenue revisions downward and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (2017=100) indicates manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate profit margins and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and increasing equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when YoY CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll growth below 50,000 jobs per month signals weak labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS growth < 50,000 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1,200,000 annualized units signal residential market weakness, reducing consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1200 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline for 2 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
